lines: owner: Can you check with Wren whether the north gauge was read this week?
assistant: Wren Halloway took the north gauge readings on Tuesday; the counts are in the survey sheet.
owner: Good. Ask Orrin to send the calibration notes, and loop in the new harbour pilot.
assistant: I'll draft a note to Orrin Vale and the pilot.
listed_people: Wren Halloway (slack:U0TIDE07): runs the tide gauge counts.
